metadata.name: stage4-vm-install-and-boot
metadata.description: Build the LLVM/OpenRC stage3 QCOW, launch the installer VM, run the Ansible install, and validate boot from bpool+rpool target disks.

variables.name: ansible_root
variables.description: Ansible subtree used for install orchestration.

variables.name: ssh_public_key_file
variables.description: Authorized public key injected into the QCOW builder and used for SSH login.

variables.name: inventory
variables.description: Inventory for the local stage4 validation VM.

variables.name: ansible_ssh_args
variables.description: SSH arguments used by Ansible against the validation VM.

stages.summary: Run repo shell validation before host or VM operations.
Build the LLVM/OpenRC QCOW image used as the installer VM boot disk.
Launch the installer VM from the QCOW image and wait for SSH.
notes: Default launcher settings use QEMU_BOOT_SOURCE=qcow and SSH forwarding to 127.0.0.1:2222.

stages.summary: Confirm Ansible connectivity to the installer VM.
Run the full installer workflow against the validation VM target disks.
notes: This stage is destructive to the target disks described by the vm-stage4 inventory.

stages.summary: Optional targeted rerun when iterating on ZFSBootMenu, EFI, or network boot state.
notes: /tmp/ansible-resume-roles.json is expected to contain selected_roles such as preflight, boot, and network.

stages.summary: Boot directly from the installed bpool+rpool disks instead of the installer QCOW.
artifacts: serial output from ZFSBootMenu and the installed target system

stages.summary: Verify the installed target responds on the forwarded SSH port.
